mapper.select: select exists ( select 1 from information_schema.tables where table_schema=database() and table_name='arc_file_text' )

select f.file_id,f.store_key,f.file_type,f.file_size,f.sha256 from arc_file f join arc_archive a on a.archive_id=f.archive_id and a.del_flag='0' left join arc_file_text t on t.file_id=f.file_id where f.file_type in ('pdf','doc','docx') and (t.file_id is null or t.source_sha256<>f.sha256 or t.retry_after<=now()) order by f.file_id limit 20
mapper.insert: insert into arc_file_text(file_id,source_sha256,content,retry_after) select f.file_id,f.sha256,#{content},if(#{retry},date_add(now(),interval 1 hour),null) from arc_file f where f.file_id=#{file.fileId} and f.sha256=#{file.sha256} and f.store_key=#{file.storeKey} on duplicate key update source_sha256=#{file.sha256},content=#{content}, retry_after=if(#{retry},date_add(now(),interval 1 hour),null)
